trigger: Lua code may be AI-generated, user-authored, untrusted, or request host, filesystem, process, package, debug, or hardware capabilities.
steps: Reject ambient os, io, package, and debug exposure.
Require every script-visible host function to appear in an explicit allow-list/capability manifest.
Reject ambient global mutation and implicit capability acquisition.
Require resource limits to be defined before untrusted or AI-generated runtime execution.
Use synthetic fixtures only for contract validation; do not execute the unsafe fixture.
failureHandling: Fail closed on unknown libraries, implicit globals, missing capability manifest, or undefined resource limits for untrusted runtime work.
proofCeiling: sandbox policy and fixture classification only; no runtime enforcement proof
